Distractor Check

Inspect whether distractors are plausible, duplicated, clueing or potentially defensible without automatically rewriting the question bank.

Supported scope
Multiple-choice questions
Design focus
Alternatives and distractors
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Local checks first
Count alternatives, validate fractions, detect empty or literal duplicate choices and flag obvious length outliers.
✓
Semantic review
Use AI for plausibility, grammatical clues, semantic duplication, absurd options and potentially defensible alternatives.
✓
Optional new distractor
Ask for one proposed distractor in a separate request and review it before using it manually.
No automatic save
Neither findings nor a generated distractor write to the question database.
No learner data
Attempts, responses, grades and profiles are not part of the AI request.
Strict choice indexing
Every returned choice index must be valid, unique and complete before semantic output is accepted.
What this plugin does

Distractor Check narrows the review to one difficult part of multiple-choice authoring: the quality of the alternatives. Structural errors remain PHP facts, while semantic quality is treated as a review suggestion.

The model response is constrained to known quality/confidence values and expected choice indexes. Invalid or malformed semantic output is discarded while deterministic findings remain available.

Features you get
Question-bank action
Launch review directly from the action menu of an accessible multichoice question.
Fraction validation
Check single-answer and multiple-answer correctness structure locally.
Duplicate detection
Find literal duplicate alternatives after normalization.
Semantic quality
Review plausibility, clueing and relation to the stem.
One-distractor suggestion
Generate a single proposed alternative without saving it automatically.
Capability isolation
Require both the plugin review capability and normal Moodle question visibility.

Also requires AI Bridge.
